behaviors.search-assignees: Open the Assignee filter and search by a person’s name to narrow the available choices.
behaviors.filter-by-assignee: Choose a person or Unassigned to show only matching tasks, with task counts shown beside each choice.
behaviors.assignee-empty-state: Choose Ana Lima to see the empty state explaining that nothing is assigned to her yet.
behaviors.clear-filters: Use Clear filters to reset the status and assignee filters and restore all tasks.

history.notes: The Assignee control is located by its `.dd-button` class, while choices use their listbox roles and visible labels. The tour uses the seeded task list and checks the count labels alongside the relevant assignee choices.

The first step leaves the filtered menu open so the next step can select Ana directly; the Unassigned step explicitly reopens the menu before checking its task counts. Status is scoped to the toolbar because task cards also have Status controls.
